outcome: care processes (e.g., transfers between neonatal units)
admissions by Index of Multiple Deprivation
cohort: The study included admissions to National Health Service neonatal units in England and Wales from 2012 to 2020.
finding: During the immediate COVID-19 period (April-June 2020), substantial changes occurred in neonatal care pathways and clinical thresholds, with a fall in total and preterm admissions, and disproportionate effects observed on black ethnic groups.
gest_age: Preterm, full-term, and extremely preterm babies.
